summary: Backend testing for NMP Sales OS Phase 2: 15/15 tests PASSED. Validated login (JWT + httpOnly cookie), dashboard KPIs (pipeline_value, today/overdue follow-ups), pipeline (7 stages), follow-ups (today/overdue/upcoming), extended lead fields (decision_maker, budget, next_follow_up, follow_up_type, expected_closure_date, competitor, probability), lead status activity logging, health_score computation, inventory seed (12 products incl. Shure search), quotation creation with extras + 18% extras GST math, quotation status workflow with activity log.

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary dict body (no Pydantic validation); could allow unknown fields to be persisted.
DELETE by ObjectId without try/except - invalid IDs raise 500 instead of 400/404.
Activity log description always uses last DB read; if doc not found, returns null silently.
pipeline_value loops through all open leads in Python; should use $sum aggregation for scale.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~750 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, leads, quotations, dashboard, inventory) for maintainability.
PUT /leads/{lead_id} and PUT /employees/{employee_id} accept raw dict - replace with Pydantic models (or at least field whitelist) to prevent injection of unwanted fields.
No try/except around ObjectId(...) conversions - malformed IDs crash with 500. Wrap with validation helper that returns 400.
calc_quotation extras_tax hardcoded at 18% - should respect a configurable GST rate (currently fine for tests but inflexible).
Startup seed admin: if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes, existing admin password is NOT updated (idempotency gap per playbook); only inserts if zero super_admins exist.
CORS: when CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True, browsers will reject. Acceptable for testing but should set explicit origins in prod.
Dashboard pipeline_value aggregation: fetches up to 2000 leads into memory; switch to MongoDB $group $sum aggregation.
seed_data_creation: Test creates a TEST_PhaseTwoLead lead + quotation; cleanup fixture deletes TEST_* leads after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2 backend endpoints (auth, dashboard/kpis, pipeline, follow-ups, leads with extended fields, inventory search, quotations with extras + status workflow, health_score) verified end-to-end via pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Use admin@nmp.com/admin123. Backend URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. Frontend testing was explicitly out of scope.
